extraction.name: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) is a comprehensive benchmark spanning 8 embedding tasks (bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization) covering 58 datasets and 112 languages, designed to evaluate and track the performance of text embedding models.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.inLanguage: 112 languages, including English, French, German, Russian, Chinese, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Turkish, Polish, Hindi, Portuguese, and others
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB aggregates datasets from existing benchmarks and public sources across 8 embedding tasks. It incorporates SemEval datasets (STS11–STS22), the BEIR benchmark for retrieval, and Kaggle competition datasets, alongside newly constructed clustering datasets collected via the public APIs of arXiv, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, and posts from Reddit and StackExchange.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web API, User-generated content data
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing public benchmark datasets (such as SemEval, BEIR, SentEval, USEB), public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv, Hugging Face datasets of Reddit and StackExchange posts, and Kaggle competition datasets.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For arXiv, bioRxiv, and medRxiv clustering datasets, S2S inputs use titles while P2P inputs concatenate title and abstract; for arXiv with multiple categories, the first category is retained and three split types are constructed (main category, secondary category within main category, and secondary category across main categories). For RedditClusteringP2P and StackExchangeClusteringP2P, title and post body are concatenated.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Input text length truncation is left up to individual models without benchmark-imposed text length limits. For classification, train embeddings are used to train a logistic regression classifier with 100 maximum iterations. For clustering, a mini-batch k-means model with batch size 32 and k equal to the number of classes is trained on embedded texts.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations are inherited from source datasets, including human-assigned category tags from paper submissions (arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv), subreddit/forum community labels (Reddit, StackExchange), human-annotated continuous similarity scores from 0 to 5 (STS datasets), binary duplicate/paraphrase judgments, and human assessments of machine-generated summaries.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Maintained via dataset and software versioning on GitHub and Hugging Face Hub (datasets and leaderboard), supporting community additions and contributions of datasets, tasks, or metrics via pull requests and an automatic leaderboard submission format.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: MTEB average scores are biased toward tasks with many datasets (notably retrieval, classification, and clustering) compared to underrepresented tasks like summarization which has only one dataset. Potential training data overlap/contamination between evaluated models and MTEB datasets was not controlled for.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 1. Lacks very long document datasets (longest texts are a few hundred words). 2. Task imbalance across the 8 tasks. 3. Multilinguality is limited: retrieval and clustering are English-only, and code datasets are missing. 4. Evaluates only natural language text embeddings, excluding multimodal text embedding applications.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking and evaluating universal text embedding models across diverse downstream tasks: bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, semantic textual similarity (STS), and summarization.
